# cato_role (Data Source)

Reads a custom or predefined RBAC role by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cato_role" "viewer" {
  role_id = "12345"
  # account_id = "123456"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_id` (String) ID of the custom or predefined role to read.

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Account to query. Defaults to the provider account_id.

### Read-Only

- `applicable_account_type` (Set of String) Applicable destination account types.
- `description` (String) Role description.
- `id` (String) Composite account and role identifier.
- `is_used_on_external_access` (Boolean) Whether external access uses the role.
- `name` (String) Role name.
- `permissions` (Attributes Set) Permissions granted by the role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))
- `predefined` (Boolean) Whether the role is predefined.

<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Granted action.
- `resource` (String) Resource identifier.
